description: Fetches one run row by id.
signature: def get_run(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str) -> RunRecord | None
docstring:
Fetch a single run.

Args:
    conn: An open connection.
    run_id: The run to fetch.

Returns:
    A RunRecord with config_json deserialized into config: dict, or None if run_id does not exist.
postconditions: Returned RunRecord.config is a dict, never a raw JSON string
Returns None rather than raising for an unknown run_id (read-only lookup semantics, distinct from update_run_status's error-on-unknown-id contract)

edge_cases.input: config_json in the row is corrupted/unparseable JSON (should not happen under normal operation)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: StorageError, since this indicates database corruption rather than a normal 'not found' case

unit_tests.name: test_get_existing_run
unit_tests.description: A run created via create_run is retrievable with matching fields.

unit_tests.name: test_get_unknown_run_returns_none
unit_tests.description: An unknown run_id returns None, not an exception.
